body: ARIES partnered with Citadel Securities for an online session featuring Hunter Morris. With 300+ registrations and 67% attendance, the event saw 65+ Data Challenge submissions. Attendees joined offline and online competitions and sessions on advanced ML in quantitative finance, resulting in 11 winners across trading, market making, and data challenges — 404 total registrations and 75% session attendance with 300 participants.
title: Citadel Securities × ARIES
description: ML in quantitative finance — 300+ registrations, 65+ Data Challenge submissions.
